mapper.insert: INSERT INTO RESERVATION_TBL ( RESERVATION_ID, ACCOUNT_ID, CONTENT_ID, CHECK_IN_DATE, CHECK_OUT_DATE, AMOUNT, PAYMENT_KEY, STATUS, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( -- 트리거(BI_RESERVATION_TBL)가 ID를 자동으로 부여하므로, ID 필드를 비우거나 NEXTVAL을 사용합니다. RESERVATION_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{accountId}, #{contentId}, #{checkInDate}, #{checkOutDate}, #{amount}, #{paymentKey}, 'PAID', SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT T1.RESERVATION_ID AS reservationId, T1.CONTENT_ID AS contentId, T1.CHECK_IN_DATE AS checkInDate, T1.CHECK_OUT_DATE AS checkOutDate, T1.AMOUNT AS amount, T2.TITLE AS title FROM RESERVATION_TBL T1 INNER JOIN STAY_DETAIL T2 ON T1.CONTENT_ID = T2.CONTENT_ID WHERE T1.ACCOUNT_ID = #{accountId} ORDER BY T1.CHECK_IN_DATE DESC
